user.title: BusWhere Shuttle Tracker
user.description:
Enter the BusWhere route URL from your browser.

Example: https://buswhere.com/theory/routes/theory_shuttle

Public shuttle routes need nothing else. For a school route behind a parent login, also enter your login email and the name of a key in secrets.yaml that holds your password.

data_description.username: The email you use to sign in at buswhere.com. Leave blank for public routes.
data_description.password_secret: Add a line like 'buswhere_password: your-password' to secrets.yaml, then put the key name (buswhere_password) here. The password itself is never stored by this integration.

reauth_confirm.title: BusWhere sign-in needed
reauth_confirm.description: BusWhere rejected the saved sign-in for this route. Confirm your login email and the secrets.yaml key holding your password (update the password in secrets.yaml first if it changed).

stops.title: Name Your Bus Stops
stops.description: Optionally rename each stop. Leave a field blank to keep the default address from BusWhere.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to BusWhere. Check the URL and try again.
error.no_data: No shuttle data found at this URL.
error.secret_required: A login email was given, so a secrets.yaml key for the password is required.
error.invalid_auth: BusWhere rejected the email/password. Check the email and the value stored in secrets.yaml.
error.missing_secret: Could not read that key from secrets.yaml. Check the key name and that secrets.yaml contains it.

init.title: BusWhere Settings
init.description:
Stop map-zones are off by default (they would affect presence detection). Turn them on only if you want each stop shown as a place on the map; they are created as passive zones.
